interface.title: EvoVis (ENAS run dashboard)
interface.field: Machine learning: evolutionary neural architecture search (ENAS)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysing the results of a finished architecture-search run
interface.what_it_is_for: A Dash dashboard for looking back over one ENAS run: its settings, the space of layers it could search, the parent-to-child lineage of the architectures it produced, and how fitness changed across generations.

data.note: The repository's bundled example run (./enas_example_run_results), fixed when the server was launched. The Overview page reports 20 generations of 20 individuals on cifar10, input [32, 32, 3], 10 classes, 12 epochs, mutation rate 20 and 4 best models used for crossover (screens/001.webp). That is 20 generations, not the 10 the explorer's plan assumed. There is no upload control and no way to switch datasets from the page. Two oddities from the replay: a C2D gene chip on industrious_manul showed filters 96, outside the gene pool's filters range [4,48,1] (check/screens/022.webp); and the 'Individual became extinct' banner appeared when the individual's node was clicked in the tree but not when the same individual was picked from the dropdown (check/screens/019.webp, check/screens/027.webp).

features.name: Grouped settings cards with hover explanations
features.general: A grid of a run's configuration values, grouped by kind (search settings, training settings), where hovering each card's icon gives a plain explanation of the setting.
features.specific: The Parameters Overview page: ENAS cards (Generations, Population, Best models crossover, Mutation rate, Max feature layers, Max classification layers) and Training cards (dataset, sample rate, input shape, classes, epochs). The card icons render as blank white squares, but hovering them shows the tooltip text.
steps: open the Parameters Overview (landing) page
read the ENAS cards
read the Training cards
hover a card's icon spot to read what the setting means
serves_tasks: Read the run's configuration values and what each one means

features.name: Search-space graph with per-component usage panel
features.general: A compound graph of the components a search may use, grouped into stages. Clicking a component shows how often it was used, a per-round usage bar chart and its allowed parameter ranges.
features.specific: Cytoscape gene-pool DAG with compound groups (preprocessing_2D, feature_extraction_2D, global_pooling_2D, dense; the dense box is drawn inside the global_pooling_2D box). Clicking a layer node fills a card with count, layer class and group, a Plotly bar chart of layers per generation, and parameter-range cards such as filters [4,48,1].
steps: zoom with the mouse wheel and drag the background to pan
click a layer node; it and its edges are highlighted white
read the count, layer class and group card
read or hover the usage-per-generation bar chart
read the parameter search-range cards
click another node to compare
serves_tasks: Look over the allowed components by stage and inspect one: how often it was used per generation and its allowed parameter ranges

features.name: Lineage graph with generation-window slider and individual picker
features.general: Show the ancestry of one chosen item as a layered graph. A searchable picker chooses the item, and a three-handle range slider sets how far back to go and which generation the item comes from.
features.specific: The Family Tree cytoscape graph. The Select Individual dropdown lists individuals of the focal generation. The three-handle Generation_1..Generation_20 slider sets the ancestry start (left), focal generation (middle) and end (right). Each child has two crossover-parent edges; the number on each edge is the one-point crossover position (per evolution.py:778-779 and the README's crossover_parents.csv description; the page itself shows no tooltip for it, screens/034.webp). The right handle is meant to extend the view to descendants, but moving it to 20 never drew any (screens/027.webp, screens/039.webp), so that part is unverified.
steps: drag or keyboard-step the middle handle to choose the focal generation (the dropdown options reset to that generation)
choose an individual in the dropdown
drag the left handle to widen or narrow how many ancestor generations are drawn
read the two crossover-parent links of each child and the crossover position on each edge
click any node to pass it to the detail panel
serves_tasks: Choose which generations to show and which generation the focal individual comes from
Pick a focal design by name and see its ancestry

features.name: Individual detail panel (metrics bars and gene chips)
features.general: For one selected item, show its overall score and each measured metric as labelled progress bars, flag whether its line ended, and list its components as chips with hover details.
features.specific: Clicking a family-tree node shows its name, an 'Individual became extinct' banner when it applies, a Fitness bar, Memory Footprint H5 / Inference Time / Accuracy cards with bars, and the Genes list as chips whose tooltip gives layer parameters. The extinct banner shows only when the individual is selected by clicking its node, not when it is picked from the dropdown (check/screens/019.webp). The panel can lag behind node clicks (screens/063.webp).
steps: click a node in the lineage graph
read the fitness and the metric cards
check the extinct banner (only reliable after a node click)
hover a gene chip to see its layer parameters
click a parent or another node to compare
serves_tasks: Inspect one design's measured performance and its structure
